data.gender_notes: Sharvishaana is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Goddess Sharvishaana is the embodiment of good fortune and prosperity. She is invoked for success, happiness, and abundance in all areas of life. Her name consists of 'Sharvi' meaning 'Goddess of Fortune' and 'Shana' meaning 'Goddess of Grace'. The name Sharvishaana carries the meaning “Goddess of Good Fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharvishaana usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of good fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Goddess Sharvishaana represents the divine feminine energy of abundance and prosperity. She is a source of inspiration and guidance for those seeking spiritual growth and material success. Her energy resonates with the vibration of gratitude, generosity, and selfless giving.
data.etymology: Sharvishaana belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Good Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvishaana total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
